name: 蓄力小球
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Generate ONE independent pixel-art avatar for an original ball-physics video account. This is a single design, not a grid. All visible artwork MUST be authentic low-resolution pixel-art with deliberate large square pixels, staircase diagonals, hard edges, flat limited-palette color clusters. Imagine a sprite authored on a 48x48 grid and enlarged with nearest-neighbor, not smooth vector art with pixel texture. No anti-aliased outlines, blurry edges, grain, shading gradients, smooth 3D, neon, plastic, lens effects, text, letters, numbers, watermark, existing game characters, faces, limbs, emoji, sports-ball patterns, UI or screenshot. Use a large recognizable ball plus at most one compact physics obstacle. Final image will be center cropped to square and displayed inside a circle. Keep the COMPLETE emblem and all fragments inside the central circular safe area with diameter 64 percent of IMAGE HEIGHT. Generous clean empty background surrounding it, bold silhouette readable at 48px. Design-specific art direction:
One orange-red ball visibly squashed horizontally on a very short dark-blue platform, two stepped black action ticks at upper sides. White background. Large 8-bit pixels, flat scarlet and burgundy color regions, tiny cream square highlight, humorous stubborn energy without eyes or mouth.
